content: Dibandu di mughande wusonunu Tofile
Mundumbe Tofile, batu bapwele bamamaange urende mambu amamalabene va ghari etu.
Bamarende nane dimatutsingululu na bambedji abamalabe na misu, vane dibandu, na abamaveghu mufune ulonze musamu Nzambi.
Nyimalabe yi diwelimine mewami, mu rombe burange mu motsu amamavyoghe ubongile va dibandu, mu wusonighile dyoni, mundumbe Tofile.
Nyighurendili mambu meni, mumbari wukedjabe yi malongi ame wumadile mangenze.
Yanze amayétsingule duburu du San-Batise
Mu temu adji Yirode amabilaange kaghe dji Sudé, wukebe muvaghulitsi paghu amanengulungu Sakari. Amabe mu dibuli di bavaghulitsi ba paghu di Abya. Mughatsi andi Lisabete, amabe mu kule dji Arone.
Sakari na mughatsi andi, bamabangaange basungeme va wusu Nzambi na bamaghobisaange mighaghe myotsu na marume motsu ma Fumu.
Tumbe basamabe na baane mumbari Lisabete amabe yingume, na djowubotsu babedji mbé bake binunu.
Mwa yilumbu Sakari amasalilaange Nzambi, mumba temu dyandi dibuli di bavaghulitsi ba paghu mbé djimatole.
Mu nzalusulu bavaghulitsi ba paghu, Sakari akesolu mu ukote o ghari yibuku ayi syeme yi Fumu mu yenyenze bime bi mbunge djiboti.
O dulombili, yinombu yi batu yikesambilaange mu temu adji Sakari amawendile mu uyébinyenze.
Vane-vane, yanze yi Fumu yikesundughe na yikelabene na Sakari wune ghari ndaghu, diteli o mabaale ma yivaghululu yi paghu.
Ave amayilabile, akeregheme na akebe na ghome djineni.
Tumbe yanze yikemutsingule rye: «Sakari uyabe na ghome, mumbari Nzambi amawulu dusambu dwaghu. Mughatsi aghu Lisabete owuburile mwane dibaale, na wumulughe San.
Mwane eni obe nzangu o murime aghu na bapwele wandi bobase na nzangu mu duburu dwandi.
Mumbari obe musatsi wuneni wu Fumu. Djandi, aghonwaangange malamu amelanzi. Ne akeburu, obasu na Yinyuni Yisyeme.
Oghabuse mirime mipwele mi bise Yisrayele ombu Fumu Nzambi owu.

Orughe nane yilumbi yi Nzambi abasu na Yinyuni na mangolu ma Eli mubiyitsi Nzambi. Oghabuse dinonge va ghari baane na batadji bowu na obeghe bango dilenze o dighobe di batu abasungeme. Otsonzighe mukute awube uwelimine mu uduke Fumu.»
Tumbe Sakari akewivule yanze rye: «Tsyeni nyudjabile yiri dyoni dingenze? Mumbari menu na mughatsi ami tuke binunu.»
Yanze yike muwaghule rye: «Menu, la Ghabiryele, nyidji va wusu Nzambi na nyimusalili, atsinzindighe mu uyighuvosile na mu udjabise musamu wuboti.
Kaboghu wube dibabe, kwange na temu adji mambu meni molabinine, mumba wughasinge mambu ame nziwutsingule, amodughusu mu temu adjimasikughu.»
Vane yanze amavosilaange nandi, abamabe o dulombili bamavivaange Sakari, bakekambulu mu yitsingu yandi o ghari ndaghu Nzambi.
Na epali, asamabwérunguse wuvosile batu, na djowu baketase bwena Sakari amadile dulasu o ghari ndaghu eni. Akebavosilaange yike na milembu mumbari mbé ake dibabe.
Sakari na emani bilumbu byandi byusalile Nzambi, akeghabughe o ndaghu andi.
Mu temu adjimadukaange, mughatsi andi Lisabete akabe na dimi na akesweme o ndaghu andi mu miweli miranu. Akevosaange rye:
«Labanu yese ayi Fumu amalase mu menu, amaghusule yisoni yami va wusu batu botsu.»
Yanze yitsinguli duburu du Djesu
Mu muweli awu musyamunu wu dimi di Lisabete, Nzambi akesindighe yanze Ghabiryele o musyengi Nasarete mu yinange yi Ngalile.
Wune, wumabe tsyemi dji mughetu omabe yibande yi dibaale dimanengulungu Sosefe, awu amabe mu yifumbe yi Davide. Na tsyemi eni, dine dyandi Mari.
Yanze yikerasune Mari o ghari ndaghu andi na yikemusimbe rye: «Mbolwa Mari! Fumu adji naghu amawubase na myule.»
Mari amaregheme na akekambulu mu munongu mbolu adji yanze amamuveghe, na vane-vane, akekéwivulaange divindughulu di mbolu eni.
Yanze yikemutsingule rye: «Wuyalabe ghome Mari, wumadile yese yi Nzambi.
Na mapape, wube na dimi na wubure mwane dibaale awulughe Djesu.
Djandi obe muneni na onengulu Mwane Nzambi-Pungu. Fumu Nzambi omubyatse kaghe nane Davide kule andi abilaange.
Na djandi obyamaange mutubu na mutubu mu mukute Sakobe, na bukaghe bwandi bughobe tena disukusulu.»
Mari akewivule yanze rye: «Dyoni tsyeni dyurungulile ubile, menu awu nyikivu tsyemi?»
Yanze yike muwaghule rye: «Yinyuni Yisyeme yurughe mu ndedju na mangolu ma Nzambi-Pungu mowughumbe. Ladibandu mwane awubure wube wusyeme, onengulu Mwane Nzambi.
Lisabete yiburu yaghu ne nane ake yinunu, djawandi ekelisi ubure mwane andi dibaale. Djandi awu bamanengilaange yingume ake na dimi di miweli misyamunu.
Mumbari vagha dyambu divure ombu Nzambi.»
Mu dyoni, Mari akevose rye: «Nyidji musatsi Fumu, kaboghu motsu madughusu nane wutsivosile.» Na yanze yikemusile.
Mari elinguli Lisabete yiburu yandi
Mu bilumbu abimadukaange, Mari amareleme nowende mbangu-mbangu o mikongu o musyengi yinange yi Sudé.
Anokote o ndaghu Sakari, akesimbe Lisabete.
Lisabete anowulu mbolu Mari, mwane andi akekunge o ghari modji andi. Vane-vane, Lisabete akebase na Yinyuni Yisyeme.
Na akebwaghe mughamu wuneni novose rye: «Mari, Nzambi amawupuyile myule wuvyoghulile baghetu botsu na mwane wandi amadile myule o modji aghu!»
Mu dyoni, Lisabete akewivule rye: «Tembusu menu yi nyivu, mulabene na ngudji Fumu ami?
Labati, ave nyiwululu mbolu aghu, mwane nosangughe na nzangu o modji ami.
Mari, myule ombu ndedju awutsisinge mambu amanziwulu mumbari Fumu omadughusu nane amavosile.»
Dwimbu du Mari
Mari akevose rye:

content.text: «Nyuyitsaange Fumu, mu monyu ami wotsu,
na nyibase na nzangu mu Nzambi, Mughobutsi ami.
Nyudivaghanga, mumbari amatsune tembusu menu musatsi andi.
Kaboghu, ubandile na muni, kule na kule bondengilaange mughetu myule,
mumbari Nzambi Mangolu amapayile mambu amaneni.
Dine dyandi disyeme,
na yingebe yandi yubangage kule na kule
mu djowu abemudumi.
Amalase mambu maneni na mangolu mandi,
amapanze bango dunangu,
amarambuse bakaghe mu bitsighe byowu,
na amabyatse abakesunze.
Amabase maboti ombu bango nzale,
na akeghabuse bisine myowu na myowu.
Amawamuse Yisrayele, musalitsi andi,
asamalibene ulase yingebe yandi,
nane amavangenine na bakule betu,
ombu Aberaame na bateghule bandi mutubu na mutubu.»

content: Mari akevyose miweli miryeru ombu Lisabete, mbana akeghabughe o dimbu dyandi.
Duburu du San-Batise
Temu ubure djinotole, Lisabete akebure mwane dibaale.
Biburu na bambatsi ba dimbu na bédjabi bwena Fumu amalase yingebe yandi ombu Lisabete, bakeyésaghe va mosi nandi.
Yisambwali yi bilumbu yinovyoghe, ayi munane, bamarughe mu yirebe mwane na bamaronde umunengile Sakari nane tadji andi.
Tumbe ngudji andi akevose rye: «Nesi, onengulu San.»
Batu beni bakemuwaghule rye: «Mu biburu byaghu, vagha mutu amanengulungu mu dine dyeni dine.»
Na bamaghebule tadji andi mu muwivule tsyeni onengilile mwane andi.
Sakari akevonde yasi yi dusimbi na akerende rye: «San la dine dyandi.» Na botsu bamakambulu.
Vane-vane, mbembu andi djikepandughe, akebande wuvose na akedodise Nzambi.
Ghome djimabase mu botsu abamabe mu mighule. Mu mikongu myotsu mi Sudé, bakevosaange bilombi bi mambu meni.
Botsu abamadiwulu, bakedikelulaange: «Munongu mwane yi obe?» Dingenze, Fumu amabe nandi.
Dwimbu du Sakari
Sakari, tadji mwane eni, anobe abasu na Yinyuni Yisyeme, akebighe rye:

content.text: «Duyitsu ombu Fumu Nzambi dji Yisrayele.
Djandi, amayilingule noghobule mukute andi.
Amatutindile Mughobutsi mangolu
va ghari bateghule ba Davide, musalitsi andi,
nane amavosile va kale mu babiyitsi bandi basyeme.
Mutudjeyise ombu bavinitsi, notukawule va makake ma bambeni betu.
Anane amalasile yingebe yandi ombu baghulu betu,
akerangimine yivighu yandi yisyeme.
Anane Nzambi amaghanine kaka ombu Aberaame tadji etu,
mu tugharusu wumusalile na mangolu,
payi tumaghobughe va makake ma bavinitsi betu.
Tukebangaange tuwelimine na tusyeme va wusu andi,
bilumbu byotsu bi monyu etu.
Na ndedju mwane kali, unengulungu “Mubiyitsi wu Nzambi-Pungu”,
mumbari, uyenewendaange va wusu Fumu mu tsonzighe manzile mandi,
udjabise mukute andi dughobutsu dwandi na dutandu du mabi mandi.
Yine, Nzambi mu yingebe na durondu dwandi, osunduse mu djetu, yidjalale yandi ayivu nane dimengi di nyangu adiruyili o djulu.
Oyimonitse botsu abetsani otsi piseme na mu yidumbitsi yi dufu, mu tusungighe mu nzile duvotsu.»

content: Mwane eni amaneghaange nowarange mu Yinyuni. Amatsanaange mu bakumu, kwange na yilumbu ayi amapalile va ghari mughungi wu Yisrayele.
